items.title: Diocletian’s Palace (Split)
items.summary: A living Roman palace at the heart of Split.

body.value: Explore cellars, squares, and narrow streets inside the palace walls.

items.title: Dubrovnik Old Town
items.summary: Medieval streets, walls, and UNESCO heritage.

body.value: Walk the walls and visit small museums and historic sites.

items.title: Pula Arena
items.summary: One of the best-preserved Roman amphitheaters.

body.value: A must-see if you visit Istria—often hosts events and concerts.

items.title: Museums & Cafés (Zagreb)
items.summary: Art, quirky museums, and local café culture.

body.value: Zagreb is great for a city-break vibe beyond the coast.
